body:
Someone pushes with more force than the task explains.

Their email reads like an ultimatum, their workout turns punitive, their negotiation opens at scorched earth; old anger is riding in on ordinary effort.

With Mars conjunct Lilith, the person making the sanctioned push is also carrying the anger that never got a direct fight.

So they swing at the small task with the big fight's force.

Things may get done fast, but everyone nearby can tell the fight is bigger than the task, and some begin answering the fight instead.
